title: The Oathstone
text: A standing stone where knights swore oaths, its face carved with their names, hundreds of them, the oldest worn almost smooth. One name has been scratched out, gouged deep, and something else written over it, in letters that hurt to look at.

options.label: The bravest swears an oath on the stone, beside the hundreds who swore before.

outcomes.text: The stone takes the oath. So does the one who swore it, and they are bound to it now, for good or ill.

options.label: The sharpest eye reads what was written over the gouged name, though it hurts to look.

outcomes.text: A curse on an oathbreaker, and the name of a House you know.

options.label: Break the stone, and every oath sworn upon it.

outcomes.text: Every oath ever sworn on it is released, and the air feels clean.
Every oath ever sworn on it is broken, and the oathbreakers wake.
